review_improvement: Converts an unversioned root package/reboot instruction into an exact signed, console-observed and rollback-capable driver installation transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: `apt install amdgpu` is repository-state dependent and can change packages without the testcase changing. DKMS success, initramfs content, module signature and the kernel actually booted are separate checkpoints. A post-boot rocm-smi result must account for every stable-mapped GPU, because partial module binding can still display some plausible information.
